metadata.title: समान नागरिक संहिता और आदिवासी परंपराएं | Universal Civil Code and Tribal Customary Laws
metadata.description: In light of recent developments in Uttarakhand where a bill regarding the Universal Civil Code (UCC) has been passed, discussions have reignited regarding the implications of such legislation, particularly on tribal communities. Notably, the government has made an exception for tribal communities, keeping them out of the purview of the UCC. However, despite this exception, tribal communities remain opposed to the UCC. To delve deeper into this issue, we turn to the insights of two tribal intellectuals: Dr. Jitendra Meena and Anthony Debbarma. These intellectuals provide valuable perspectives on why tribal communities resist the UCC, shedding light on this contentious issue's complexities and concerns.
